reviews.title: Excelent
reviews.comment: I purchased this AULA keyboard and it exceeded my expectations. The keys feel comfortable and are very responsive whether typing or gaming. It feels sturdy and well-built, and the design looks modern and sleek. The connection is stable and easy to set up. It’s a great option if you’re looking for a functional, comfortable keyboard with good value for the price.

reviews.title: actual good bootleg keyboard
reviews.comment:
normally I hate clone products and use brand name stuff exclusively but after seeing how expensive the real deal was I decided to take a gamble on this one since it had good reviews and boy did it pay off
this is probably the best keyboard I’ve ever used, normally I use blues exclusively but these (relatively) quiet magnetic switches feel amazing
great for anything from rhythm games to shooters or just plain typing
form factor is a great compromise between minimal size and functionality, it takes some time to get used to the arrow placement but it’s good
I got this on sale for around $30 but it’s easily better than a $200 name brand keyboard in my opinion
reviews.author: Different Name

reviews.title: Solid Build, Great Sound, and Impressive Lighting Options
reviews.comment:
I’ve been using the AULA WIN68 HE keyboard for a while now, and it’s been a great experience overall. The compact size is small enough to save desk space but not so small that it feels restrictive—everything is still right where you need it. The function key functionality is seamless, making it easy to access all the extra commands without breaking your flow. The typing sound is crisp and satisfying without being too loud, and the build quality is excellent—solid and heavy enough that it won’t slide around, even if you accidentally bump it. The RGB lighting is another standout, offering a wide range of patterns and configurations to match any setup. While the software initially seemed a bit sketchy, after doing some research and testing I was able to find a great actuation point that feels perfect for my typing style. One thing I’m still unsure about is the “different switches” option in the software—it’s visible, but I’m not entirely certain what it changes, if anything. Considering the overall quality, sound, build, lighting, and features, this keyboard delivers an impressive experience for such a budget-friendly price.
Overall, I highly recommend this keyboard to anybody looking for a budget-friendly gaming keyboard!
